{{Quote|Imperial Diplomats made repeated attempts to recruit the most infamous bounty hunters in the Galaxy, but were turned down every time.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]]|<ref name="Timeline 4: The Empire Changes Strategy">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 4: The Empire Changes Strategy|int=Timeline 4: The Empire Changes Strategy}}</ref>}}
The '''Imperial Diplomatic Service''' was an organization that served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. The Imperial Diplomatic Service answered directly to the head of the [[Sphere of Expansion and Diplomacy]]. Officers of the Diplomatic Service were typically distinguished by their red uniforms. During the Great Galactic War, they tried to recruit some of the best [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] in the galaxy, but failed miserably.

They also successfully helped facilitate the return of [[House of Thul|House Thul]] to Alderaan from exile.<ref>{{TORcite|type=codex|House Thul}}</ref>
